units: Ḥag. 12ᵇ רוח בס׳ the wind rests on the storm, for we read (Ps. CXLVIII, 8) as to the wind (ruaḥ), storm does its bidding; וס׳ תלויה וכ׳ (not תלוי) and the storm depend son the arm of the Lord; Yalk. Am. 543; Yalk. Ps. 883; Y. Ḥag. II, beg. 77ᵃ הרוח תלויה בס׳ the ruaḥ depends on the s’ʿarah; וס׳ עשאה הקב״ה כמין וכ׳ and the Lord has made the s’ʿarah a sort of charm and suspended it on his arm; a. e.
